name: ibkr-trade-analyzer
description: Analyze Interactive Brokers (IBKR) trading history with read-only access. Generates reports on trading patterns, P&L performance, portfolio structure, cost basis, fees, cash flow, and FX. Supports Flex Web Service API and local CSV/XML file import.

interface.shortDescription: Read-only IBKR trade, P&L, portfolio, and fee analysis
interface.longDescription: Analyze Interactive Brokers activity from Flex Web Service or local CSV/XML exports. Generate structured reports for trading patterns, realized P&L, portfolio concentration, FIFO/LIFO/breakeven cost basis, fees, cash flow, FX, and risk.
defaultPrompt: Review my IBKR portfolio and position risk.
Analyze my IBKR cash and FX exposure.
